---
title: Spaghetti
id: MAR-0113
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 15
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g spaghetti
- 8 anchovy fillets
- 1 garlic clove
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 100 g tomato sauce
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Peel the garlic.
2. Chop the anchovies.
3. Sauté the garlic in a pan with the oil.
4. After 4 minutes, remove it, add the anchovies and dissolve them over very low heat.
5. Add the tomato sauce, stir and let cook for a minute.
6. Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water, drain them and pour them into the pan with 3 tablespoons of their cooking water; stir and serve.
